author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Speed up building the `TriggerResultsFilter` modules.

In a Run 3-like job with 32 threads and 24 streams this saves about 2 seconds of the startup time. In a larger job with 190 streams the construction of `TriggerResultsFilter` modules drops from 26 seconds to less than 0.1 seconds.

Detailed changes:

* Compare plain path names as strings: a pattern made only of letters, digits and underscores matches only itself, so it is compared with the `edm::HLTPathStatus` module labels as a string; an `std::regex` is built and matched only for the patterns with wildcards.

* Make `TriggerResultsFilter` an `edm::global::EDFilter`: parsing, pattern matching and dependencies are declared once per module instead of once per stream.
Each stream keeps a copy of the `triggerExpression::Data` with the event data, and shares an expression initialised once for each L1 and HLT configuration.

* The prescale counters move from `triggerExpression::Prescaler::m_counter` to a `vector` with one counter per stream, sized by `init()` from the number of streams that `TriggerResultsFilter` sets in `preallocate()`, and aligned to `std::hardware_destructive_interference_size`
The stream module users of `triggerExpression` keep a single counter and are unchanged.
 

#### PR validation:

Tested with the Run 3 HLT menu on a sample of Run 3 data with identical results.
title: Make `TriggerResultsFilter` a global filter
